### Critical
None.

### Major

1. **U49 · i, n** — `i` read the sentence-final `či` as the recipient ("I have given you [the power] to press down…").
   `či` is unmarked, so it is the subject (recipients are marked čima-da / čima-ji everywhere else in the part);
   the bracketed "[the power]" was invented. Done: `i` now "You pressed down for me the neck of the strong and the
   rump of the wrestler." (ögbe after a converb taken as benefactive); the note says so, and records the other
   possible reading ("you gave them up") as the doubt it is.
2. **U59, U60 · i, n** — Speaker and quote handling. U59 is plainly Chinggis speaking (first person `bi`), and runs
   without a break into U60–U61, whose closing mark is at jabuγdaqu"; yet the note called U59 "a remark within the
   narration" and the opening mark was put at U60, so U59 stood outside the speech. Done: opening mark supplied in
   `i` at U59 (before "Again"), removed from U60; notes rewritten.
3. **U61 · i, l, n** — Force/subject wrong. `i` made Qubilai "form a thousand with you", i.e. with himself
   (Čima-luγ̇a "with you" is Qubilai; the thousand-maker is Bedüün, ima of the previous unit). Done: `i` "Forming a
   thousand with you and taking counsel together, [he] should proceed,” he said."; `l` "to-be-gone-with" →
   "to-be-acted"; note explains the supplied subject.
4. **U17–U18 · i, l, n** — Dangling converb. Shiratori's period falls after daγ̇uliba (U16), so oṅžaldažu
   (Ming 被斷絕着, passive) belongs with the Naiman/Merkid sentence, but `i` hung "cutting off the realm of the
   leaders" on the subject of the previous sentence. Done: U17 "With the leading nation cut off," (also brings
   erkid into line with the published "erkid irge … the leading people", §153); U18 now continues in lower case;
   `l` "being-cut-off"; note says why.
5. **U21–U23 · i, n** — The Jaqa Gambu chain was garbled: "[took]" in brackets, then an unexplained "they laid hands
   on and seized him", and qaγačaγsan-i (accusative participle) turned into a finite "he … parted".
   Done: U21 "Next, [him] who had turned enemy and broken away,"; U22 "Jürchedei lured, by a stratagem, Jaqa
   Gambu,"; U23 "who had broken away and was finished; laying hands on him, he seized him, and it was
   accomplished." Notes adjusted (the object -i carried over, the verbs γardažu barižu take it up).

    note corrected.
18. **U42 · i** — "your keepsakes," hung loose before the next unit. Done: "as your own keepsakes,"
    (gerijes(i)-jen is reflexive, Ming 遺念 自的行).

### Findings considered and refused

- **`l` name forms (Chinggis, Jürchedei, Jaqa Gambu, Ibaqa, Bo'orchu, Ashiq-Temür, Uruqud, Baljuna in `l` versus
  Shiratori's Žürčedei, Boγ̇orču, Ašiγ-Temür …).** The conventions say Shiratori's form in `l`; the published
  parts (e.g. 204–207: "Chinggis Qaγan", "Münlig", but "Boγ̇orču-da") mix the two. Normalising ~30 units would
  go beyond published practice; left, and put to the owner (residual doubts).
- **U13 "reached Lake Baljuna and drank its water" (Mongol order is "drinking, reached").** The converb -ra is
  unplaced and the note says so; the English order is a readable choice, not a mistake. Kept.
- **U36 "should think", U57 "will be" (büleġe is past).** Both are signalled in the notes as generalising/
  hortative readings; the conditional frame justifies them. Kept.
- **U32/U35 "the right" for töre.** Matches the published "right things", "what is right" (§§121, 178). Kept
  (see doubts).
- **U33 "against the enemy" for daisun küġün-dür ("among enemy men").** Idiomatic; `l` keeps the literal. Kept.
- **U20 "on account of his two daughters"** (note itself says the link is mysterious). Kept as the note's honest
  position.
- **U66 "did not stay behind … did not move on"** — the note flags the reading; no better one from the Ming.
- **U6 γol "centre".** The Ming 中軍 decides it against the glossary's "ravine"; correct.
- **Lemma "qadqul-" + "-ldu-" (letter l counted twice).** Follows the published glossary convention; kept.
- **Lemma "morin/mori".** Known-forms use both; kept.
- **Straight apostrophes in names** (Bo'orchu) — as in 204–207.

### Residual doubts

- U49 ögbe after daružu: benefactive "for me" versus "gave (them) up".
- U61: the supplied "[he]" (Bedüün) as subject; the alternative is that Qubilai is told to form a thousand with
  someone else.
- U67–U68: žübčigsen "made peace" versus "attached himself" (glossary žübči- 'join on'); the whole pair is obscure.
- U1: who grieves (we/I) — unstated.
- U8 žiloγ̇a "rein" (Ming 牽胷) and the figure "door and rein were opened".
- U29–U30: the sense of ülige čeġeži čin-u ügeġüi (whose heart, whose dislike).
- U19 "in the clash" attaches to the scattering; the Ming gives no more.
- U2 aman alda-: "gave his word" versus the idiom "opened his mouth first" of §182.
- "töre" as "the right" reads strangely in U32/U35; "principle" (the Ming 道理) is the alternative.
- Name of the quote opening at U59 (before "Again") is a choice; Shiratori prints none.

### House renderings to add to conventions.md (for 208–210)

- Names in `i`: Qalaqaljid-Eled (Shiratori Qara-Qalžid-Eled), Qori-Shilemün (printed Quri-Šilemün here; the
  Thousand Guards), Jaqa Gambu, Ibaqa-Beki, Ashiq-Temür, Alchiq, Bedüün, Qubilai, Jelme, Jebe, Sübegetei, Dodai,
  Doqolqu, Qunan (of the Genigedei; his people Genigesid), Kökösös, Degei, Usun-Ebügen, Jüchi, Lake Baljuna,
  the Qalqa (river).
- inže (Ming 從嫁) → "dowry attendant(s)".
- soγ̇or → "clash" (not a name).
- noγai (dörben noγas(i)-jan) → "dogs", not "hounds".
- erkid + noun → "leading …" (erkid čeriġüd-i "the leading troops"; erkid ulus "the leading nation").
- ögbe after a converb (daružu ögbe-že): tentatively benefactive, "did for (me)".
- uchuma (Ming 箭名): an arrow-name, left as "uchuma".
- aman alda- → "gave his word" (compare aman negegsen "opened his mouth first").
- sojurγažu žarliγ bolba → "showing favour, issued a decree".
- Quotes: curly “ ” ‘ ’ from 196 on; opening marks Shiratori omits are supplied in `i` only and said in the note
  (here U59, U71).

### Findings considered and refused

- **Lemma üiled- (U3, U4, U69, U70, gloss) against the glossary's üile- + -düdkün.** The glossary itself says the division of that ending is
  uncertain; gloss.json and units agree with each other and the stem üiled- is stated with its derivation. Kept; flagged.
- **U8 `i` still has a figure ("the door and the breast-strap were opened").** Only the word was corrected; the figure is the pass-1 reading and
  has no better one from the Ming.
- **Names in `l` (Žürčedei etc.).** Pass 1's refusal stands (mixed in published parts).
- **Notes saying "the glossary", "the published qamtudγaba", "§153/§158/§182".** Project-internal but they point to real, checkable places;
  kept.
- **naiman-i "(the word also means 'eight')"** — supported by the glossary's naiman; kept.
- **Known forms with only a variant Ming (e.g. alalduqui 厮殺的 for 相殺的, ileġesü 敎去呵, qojar 二/兩箇, tere 那箇)** — same sense; no broadening.
- **U49 ögbe, U61 "[he]"** — pass-1 doubts stand; no better reading from the Ming.

### Residual doubts

- žiloγ̇a (U8): the word and the figure.
- üiledbe / üiledürün / üiledkün: lemma üiled- versus the glossary's üile-.
- bütüġežüġü-že: stem and endings (U23).
- ünži- (U66): 住 'stay' and 休 'rest' are the Ming's; the form is not otherwise attested here.
- U1 who grieves; U67–U68 žübči- ("made peace" / "attached himself").
- čerbin-e "to the cherbi": whether a rank, a body or a plural.
